messages:
Maya: Heads-up — annual planning offsite proposed for Mon-Wed, Nov 10-12. Goal: finalize 2026 roadmap pillars + agree on top 3 cross-team bets. Need availability, facilitation preferences, and any must-cover customer asks ASAP.
Jonas: +1 those dates look good for me. Do we have a venue or remote option?
Maya: Hybrid — SF office + remote. Venue TBD but reserving 20 seats. Remote-first agenda blocks.
Priya: Can we add a dedicated slot for customer-driven asks triage? I have 4 items from Sales that should be considered for Q1.
Maya: Yes — plan is: Day 1 strategy & context, Day 2 deep-dive by theme (infra, UX, reliability, integrations), Day 3 decisions + OKR drafting. Customer asks triage on Day 2 morning.
Hannah: Suggest we pre-sort asks into: immediate (must commit), candidate (needs scoping), backlog. Could use a simple rubric: "impact x effort" and whether it's compliance/regulatory.
Owen: I can run the rubric session. I'll prepare a template. Also we should set launch criteria for any candidate product bets (quality/regressions, latency SLOs, cost target).
Luca: Agree. For facilitation, happy to co-run breakout for "Dedicated & Private" deployment asks.
Maya: Thanks — assigning: Owen -> rubric + session facilitation; Luca -> dedicated/private breakout; Priya -> gather sales/customer asks and short writeups due by Nov 1. Jonas -> logistics + venue. Hannah -> OKR drafting template.
plans-bot: (poll) Please vote on preferred facilitation format: 1) Working groups with rotating facilitators, 2) Single facilitator per track, 3) Open fishbowl. Cast vote by EOD Thu.
Jonas: Quick agenda skeleton I sketched: ```
Day 0 (evening): informal dinner (optional)
Day 1: context, metrics baseline, theme framing, lightning customer stories
Day 2: breakout tracks + customer asks triage + cross-team dependencies map
Day 3: decision reviews, OKR drafting, next steps & owners
```
Priya: I'll add the 4 customer asks to the shared doc and tag owners. Short format: one-paragraph problem statement, quant metric, suggested outcome, minimum success criteria.
Hannah: For OKR template, see snippet: `Objective line`, `Key Result (metric + target)`, `Owner`, `Dependencies`, `Risks/assumptions`. I'll drop into the doc.
Maya: Pre-reads: please review 1) Q3 customer impact report, 2) infra cost analysis, 3) recent reliability incidents summary. Links in the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/planning/2026-prework (add comments)
Luca: One operational ask — can we reserve an "escalation lane" for any live incidents during the offsite? eng-oncall will stay on call but we should avoid deep engineering sessions if there's an outage.
Maya: Good call. We'll keep Day 1 low-risk deep-dive; Day 2 can be heavier but ensure critical services staffed.
Owen: Prework action list I will circulate: 1) rubric doc, 2) example scored asks, 3) short explainer on latency/cost tradeoffs. Target to share by Oct 25.
Priya: Note for Sales asks — two are compliance-related (customers require data residency + audit logs) which may be enterprise commitments. Marking them high priority.
Jonas: Logistics note: travel stipend + hotel block details to follow. Remote folks — we'll provision a dedicated Zoom room + Miro board.
Maya: Excellent. If no objections, I'll lock dates and start calendar invites tomorrow. Please confirm availability and that you're OK with assigned prework by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
Jonas: 👍
Priya: 👍 will do the ask list
Hannah: ✅
Owen: 👍 working on rubric
Luca: ✅
plans-bot: Reminder scheduled: Prework checklist due Nov 1 at 09:00 PST.
